name: tawsel
description: Tawsel delivery application workspace around the retained routing Engine

scripts.build: npm run build -w @tawsel/shared && npm run build -w @tawsel/api && npm run build -w @tawsel/web
scripts.check: npm run audit && npm run lint && npm run contracts:lint && npm run contracts:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test:ci && npm run build
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @tawsel/shared && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors green,blue "npm run dev -w @tawsel/api" "npm run dev -w @tawsel/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @tawsel/shared && npm run typecheck -w @tawsel/api && npm run typecheck -w @tawsel/web && npm run typecheck -w @tawsel/api-client
scripts.test:fast: npm run build -w @tawsel/shared && vitest run --project fast
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w @tawsel/shared && vitest run --project integration
